chunks: My father (rah) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sayf, from Salim ibn Ghanim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever says, when he goes to his bed, 'La ilaha illallah' a hundred times, Allah builds for him a house in Paradise. And whoever seeks forgiveness when he goes to his bed a hundred times, his sins fall away just as the leaves of a tree fall off.

key_terms.تَحَاتَّتْ ذُنُوبُهُ: His sins fell away / were shed
key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: The declaration of monotheism, 'There is no god but Allah'
key_terms.یَأْوِی إِلَی فِرَاشِهِ: He goes to his bed / rests for the night

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual benefits of reciting specific dhikr before sleeping?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith emphasizes the transformative power of nightly devotions, linking the recitation of Tawhid to architectural reward in Paradise and Istighfar to the rapid shedding of sins. The imagery of falling leaves underscores the ease and completeness of divine forgiveness for those who maintain this consistent spiritual routine before rest.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to us by Sa’d b. Abdillah from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa from al-Hussain b. Sayf from Salim b. Ghanim from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “

Allah builds a house in Paradise for one who recites Laa ilaaha illallaah a hundred times before going to bed. And the sins of one who recites Astaghfirullah a hundred times before going to bed are destroyed in the same way as dry leaves fall off from a tree.”
